what: axis-1 and R2 run with the same command and the same thresholds on both sides of the holiday relabel. **The two are not blind in the same way.** axis-1 draws its site population from body text, so a label move cannot reach it and its identical status_counts are a real no-regression result. R2's audit gate (rate, violations) is likewise unchanged — but its recovery candidate queue comes from the gold EVT surface set, so moving 138 spans into EVT moved the queue with them.
thresholds_pinned_at: the pre-relabel measurement; raising them to pass is out of scope

r2_candidates_this_relabel_created.why_it_matters: The next R2 recovery round would otherwise credit these to recovery. Two are places THIS ruler sends to DAT — a period head follows, so the correct span is the longer DAT one rather than a bare EVT. Inside gold the same shape occurs 15 times (11 adjacent, 4 sharing the head across a coordination) and the ledger holds those sites at DAT through site_exceptions; these two sit in text gold never labelled, so only this record covers them.
